notes.cancelOnNavigate: Press it and navigate away before the response arrives: the request is aborted and the component reports no error.
notes.noRetry: This endpoint uses `retry: false` so the error shows immediately. TanStack Query retries 3 times with exponential backoff by default.
notes.cascade: If the result is “Not matching”, the `mui` layer sits above `utilities` — re-check `@layer` in globals.css and `enableCssLayer` in layout.tsx.
notes.themeBridge: If the class on <html> does not match next-themes, the bridge in theme-provider.tsx is broken.
notes.themeHydrating: Waiting for mount — client-side state cannot be read yet.
notes.errorBoundary: The error is thrown once; the “Try again” button in the boundary calls `retry()` and the component works again. The boundary uses `catchError` from `next/error`: `redirect()` and `notFound()` still pass through instead of being swallowed as a generic error.
notes.authInterrupts: `forbidden()` and `unauthorized()` require `experimental.authInterrupts: true` in next.config.ts — otherwise the build fails.
notes.skeletonShape: A skeleton must keep the size of the real content, otherwise the page jumps when the data arrives.
notes.muiSystemProps: MUI v9 removed the system props (gap, flex, py, px, alignItems) from the direct prop surface — they must go through `sx`, or they leak onto the DOM as invalid HTML attributes.
